headline: Has Jackson finishing improved?
body: I haven’t watched a lot of Villa games this season but as a Chelsea fan I’m well aware of how well Jackson is good at being in positions to score but horrible at finishing. I’m a bit surprised to see that he is overachieving his xG this season. Has his finishing improved or just lucky or too early to tell?   submitted by   /u/upinthe6 [link]   [comments]
